definitions.explanation: A painting or drawing whose subject is natural scenery such as mountains, rivers, fields, or townscapes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{風景画|ふうけいが}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}った→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧。
examples.english: I hung a landscape painting on the wall.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{風景画|ふうけいが}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|か}く→描く：28436_kaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{得意|とくい}→得意：03455_tokui⟧だ。
examples.english: She is good at painting landscapes.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{美術館|びじゅつかん}→美術館：01717_bijutsukan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な⟦{画家|がか}→画家：02583_gaka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{風景画|ふうけいが}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{数多|かずおお}く→数多く：12948_kazuooku⟧⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This art museum exhibits many landscape paintings by famous painters.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{風景|ふうけい}→風景：03591_fuukei⟧ (scenery, landscape) + {画|が} (picture, painting). The {画|が} suffix names a genre of picture, as in ⟦{肖像画|しょうぞうが}→肖像画：23432_shouzouga⟧ (portrait) and {静物画|せいぶつが} (still life).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {風景画|ふうけいが}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|か}く→描く：28436_kaku⟧: to paint a landscape
- {風景画|ふうけいが}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}る→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧: to display a landscape painting
- ⟦{水彩|すいさい}→水彩：24163_suisai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{風景画|ふうけいが}: a watercolor landscape

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{肖像画|しょうぞうが}→肖像画：23432_shouzouga⟧: portrait — a picture whose subject is a person
- {山水画|さんすいが}: ink landscape painting — a traditional East Asian style of mountains and water
